partnership with Randstad's technology operating company. In August, we proudly teamed up with them
to launch Randstad Digital. We're thrilled to announce that we've made the decision to fully
integrate, with Celerity becoming the Advisory Services arm of Randstad Digital. This exciting
evolution brings us a global presence, a growing client base, and increased resources, as well as
the opportunity to provide valuable advisory services to Randstad’s clients.

Randstad Digital Advisory is your trusted digital enablement and consulting partner. We specialize
in accelerating transformation for businesses by delivering tailored strategies, innovative
solutions, and strategic partnerships that unlock the full potential of your business objectives. We
firmly believe that it's no longer a question of whether your organization should embrace
digitalization but how quickly you can operationalize your strategy to gain a competitive advantage.

Our expert teams in IT Strategy, Customer Experience, Operational Excellence, and Enterprise Agility
are dedicated to facilitating digital transformation across every facet of your organization. From
reshaping customer engagement to optimizing internal processes and harnessing the power of data for
future insights, we're here to guide you every step of the way. Our approach is built on everyday
innovation, resulting in lasting results achieved in months, not years, so your business can thrive
in today's ever-changing environment.

Discover how Randstad Digital Advisory can help you thrive in the digital era. [Visit our website
for more information][69].

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

  [Human-centric solutions to optimize outcomes][30]
  
  Our customer-driven solutions cater to independent practices, offering user-friendly tools
  designed and based on feedback to support your practice’s growth and adaptability. As your
  practice expands, our technology is equipped to scale alongside you.
  
  [EHR with billing services][31]
  
  Enhance your revenue stream and reduce burden on your staff with Practice Fusion's EHR and billing
  services platform.
  
  [EHR with billing software][32]
  
  Streamline clinical, financial, and patient engagement workflows with a streamlined and efficient
  suite of solutions.
  
  [EHR][33]
  
  Optimize patient care by leveraging our easy-to-use electronic health record, allowing you to
  concentrate on delivering efficient and enhanced healthcare services for patients.
  
  [ePrescribe][34]
  
  Access certified, advanced e-prescribing capabilities to help your patients get the medications
  they need, faster.
  
  [Value-add options][35]
  
  Explore additional features, including patient engagement tools, chart retrieval services, and
  more.
* [Why Practice Fusion][36]
  
  [The Practice Fusion difference][37]
  
  We deliver a unique commitment to providing human-centric solutions custom-fit to your practice,
  backed by our dedicated support team, and enhanced by insights from the Veradigm network.
  
  [Our commitment][38]
  
  We are committed to bringing human-friendly EHR and billing technology to you, our valued
  customers, and the healthcare community as a whole.
  
  [Tailored for you][39]
  
  Our EHR and billing technology is designed to anticipate your needs and provide an intuitive
  working experience based on real customer insights.

## Built for Aesthetics.
## Not Retrofitted.

Most practice software was built for hospitals and retrofitted for aesthetics. 4D was built the
other way around. 4D EMR runs over 200 aesthetic practices on a cloud-based system for scheduling,
charting, photos, payments, and patient communication. HIPAA-compliant, accessible from any device,
and designed to cut clicks instead of adding them.
* [Appointment reminders][22]
* [Patient portal][23]
* [Easy charting][24]
* [Inventory management][25]
* [Photo storage][26]
* [Quoting][27]

There are no long-term contracts, annual maintenance fees, or extra charges for users or
workstations.

Built Different. Priced Fairly.

## Why Aesthetic Practices Choose 4D EMR

Other EMRs try to be everything for everyone. 4D EMR is purpose-built for aesthetic medicine, with
pricing that makes sense and a team that actually picks up the phone.

### Built by a Plastic Surgeon

[Designed by a practicing plastic surgeon][28] who understands aesthetic workflows, consultation
processes, and the patient journey unique to cosmetic medicine.

### True Cloud. Any Device

Access your practice from anywhere on any device with Chrome or Safari. No software installs, no IT
headaches, no waiting for updates

### No Hidden Fees. Ever.

Transparent month-to-month pricing with no long-term contracts, no per-user charges, and no extra
fees for workstations or annual maintenance.

### Switch Without the Pain

We handle your entire data migration and training so you can transition smoothly without disrupting
your practice or your patients.

Designed for Aesthetic Medicine

### Plastic & Cosmetic Practices

4D EMR was built by a plastic surgeon who understands your workflows, your patients, and your
business. Manage consultations, [documentation][29], [imaging][30], [inventory][31], and scheduling
from one intuitive platform. Every feature reflects how your practice actually operates.

### Medical
### Spas

membership management, and [point-of-sale integration][33]. Give your clients a seamless experience
from booking to checkout, all from one system your whole team can access.

### Other Aesthetic Practices

Whether your focus is medical, aesthetic, or both, 4D EMR adapts to your workflow. [Chart quickly
with customizable templates][34], track treatment plans, and [engage patients with automated
reminders][35]. Built for the pace of a high-volume practice.

4D EMR adapts to the way your aesthetic practice works. See how it fits your practice.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

CARBOGEN AMCIS, a Switzerland-based pharmaceutical process development and Active Pharmaceutical
Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted
photovoltaic system at its Hunzenschwil site in Switzerland. With this project, the company
underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

Frequently asked questions.

## Frequently asked questions.

What is clinIQ?

clinIQ is a clinic operations platform that adds real-time patient flow management, digital
check-in, RTM billing automation, and pre-authorization tracking on top of your existing EHR. It is
not a replacement for your EHR — it is the operational layer your EHR was never built to provide.

How long does it take to go live?

Most clinics are fully operational within 3–5 business days. EHR connection is same-day for
supported systems. Staff training takes under two hours.

Will it work with my EHR?

clinIQ integrates with all major EHR systems including Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Cerner,
NextGen, AdvancedMD, and Tebra. If yours is not on that list, ask us — we likely have a connector or
can build one.

What is RTM billing and how does clinIQ automate it?

Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM) is a set of Medicare and commercial payer CPT codes
(98975–98981) that allow clinics to bill for monitoring patients between visits using connected
devices or apps. clinIQ identifies eligible patients, tracks compliance minutes automatically, and
routes billing codes to your billing team or clearinghouse.

What does RTM billing pay per patient?

Most clinics average $120–$150 per RTM-enrolled patient per month. A 50-patient RTM panel generates
approximately $6,000–$7,500 in additional monthly revenue — with minimal added staff workload.

How does the digital check-in work?

Patients receive an SMS or email before their appointment. They complete intake forms, insurance
verification, and consent on their smartphone — before they arrive. When they walk in, front desk
check-in takes under 60 seconds.

How does pre-authorization automation work?

clinIQ pulls procedure and payer data from your schedule, submits prior auth requests
electronically, and tracks approval status in a single dashboard. Denials trigger automatic appeal
workflows. You stop chasing approvals.

Is clinIQ HIPAA compliant?

Yes. clinIQ is built to HIPAA standards with end-to-end encryption, role-based access controls, and
a signed BAA for every clinic. All data is stored and transmitted within HIPAA-compliant
infrastructure.

How is clinIQ different from our EHR?

Your EHR is a medical record and billing system. clinIQ is an operations platform. EHRs track what
happened — clinIQ manages what is happening right now: who is waiting, who is with a provider, which
RTM patients are compliant this month, which prior auths are pending. These are different jobs.

What does clinIQ cost?

Pricing is based on clinic size and modules selected. Most clinics recover the full cost within the
first month through RTM billing alone. Request a demo and we will put together a specific ROI
projection for your patient volume.

## Video surveillance application

Security cameras are a must nowadays. Commercial and residential establishments often have
surveillance systems installed to deter crimes. However, if you installed one with several cameras,
chances are you need a [tool][184] that enables you to configure it. **Dahua SmartPSS** is an
application that enables you to **manage your Dahua surveillance camera**. With this, you can **view
real-time footage** of several channels. You can also **receive alerts** when your system detects
suspicious activities.

### Manage your surveillance devices

Dahua SmartPSS is **an all-in-one, full-featured** [video surveillance][186] application that
integrates all Dahua network cameras and storage devices into one interface. This app provides
**efficient device management**, video monitoring, and playback. It also allows you to set up a
video wall and configure alarm and device analytics. The installation is easy and straightforward.
However, note that an **NVR tool** is needed as it allows you to define the password for accessing
the app.

The app features an **easy-to-use and intuitive **interface that has **two main tabs**. The **Home
**tab enables you to manage the parameters of your cameras. Meanwhile, the **Add** tab lets you add
[security cameras][187] to your system. Adding a device to your app only entails specifying a few
details, including name, IP, SN or domain name, group name, and your credentials. More so, it lets
you add and manage **up to 256 devices.**

More than being able to manage your devices, one of the other highlights of this program is its
ability to **set alerts for various events** that you want to track. You can set up alerts for
camera masking, video loss, and motion detection, among others. Moreover, with the latest version,
Dahua SmartPSS **supports video structuring**. You can add a target detection module, which includes
**real-time target detection** for moving objects, such as vehicles and pedestrians. 

### Developer background and ecosystem

Dahua SmartPSS is developed by Dahua Technology, a major global provider of **video-centric AIoT
solutions**. The software is part of a broader ecosystem that includes **IP cameras, NVRs, DVRs, and
cloud services**, enabling seamless integration across surveillance hardware and software.

### Advanced AI and intelligent analytics

Recent versions of Dahua SmartPSS incorporate **AI-powered analytics**, including **facial
recognition, perimeter protection, and behavior analysis**. These features enhance traditional
monitoring by enabling **smarter threat detection**, reducing false alarms, and improving overall
surveillance efficiency in both residential and commercial settings.

### Remote access and mobile integration

The platform supports **remote monitoring capabilities**, allowing users to access live feeds and
playback from different locations. Integration with mobile apps like DMSS extends functionality,
enabling **real-time alerts, camera control, and notifications** directly on smartphones for
improved accessibility and convenience.

### Data storage and playback flexibility

With support for **multiple storage configurations**, including local drives, NVR systems, and cloud
options, the software provides **flexible video recording and playback solutions**. Users can easily
search footage using **time, event type, or smart detection filters**, making investigations faster
and more efficient.

### Security concerns and compliance discussions

As with many surveillance platforms, Dahua Technology has faced **global scrutiny regarding data
security and privacy practices**. Users are encouraged to follow **best practices**, such as
securing networks, updating firmware regularly, and limiting unauthorized access to ensure safe
usage.

### System requirements and performance considerations

While Dahua SmartPSS is feature-rich, it may require **moderately powerful hardware**, especially
when managing multiple high-resolution camera feeds. Performance can vary depending on the number of
connected devices, making **system optimization and proper configuration** essential for smooth
operation.

### A handy tool for your surveillance system

All in all, Dahua SmartPSS is **a must-have **[**device manager**][188] if you have the Dahua
surveillance system installed on your property. The app allows you to **manage your devices more
efficiently** and **configure them easily**. It lets you view real-time footage and even set alarms
for various events that you want to track. With this, you will no longer be caught off-guard
whenever something happens.

## Video surveillance application

Security cameras are a must nowadays. Commercial and residential establishments often have
surveillance systems installed to deter crimes. However, if you installed one with several cameras,
chances are you need a [tool][184] that enables you to configure it. **Dahua SmartPSS** is an
application that enables you to **manage your Dahua surveillance camera**. With this, you can **view
real-time footage** of several channels. You can also **receive alerts** when your system detects
suspicious activities.

### Manage your surveillance devices

Dahua SmartPSS is **an all-in-one, full-featured** [video surveillance][186] application that
integrates all Dahua network cameras and storage devices into one interface. This app provides
**efficient device management**, video monitoring, and playback. It also allows you to set up a
video wall and configure alarm and device analytics. The installation is easy and straightforward.
However, note that an **NVR tool** is needed as it allows you to define the password for accessing
the app.

The app features an **easy-to-use and intuitive **interface that has **two main tabs**. The **Home
**tab enables you to manage the parameters of your cameras. Meanwhile, the **Add** tab lets you add
[security cameras][187] to your system. Adding a device to your app only entails specifying a few
details, including name, IP, SN or domain name, group name, and your credentials. More so, it lets
you add and manage **up to 256 devices.**

More than being able to manage your devices, one of the other highlights of this program is its
ability to **set alerts for various events** that you want to track. You can set up alerts for
camera masking, video loss, and motion detection, among others. Moreover, with the latest version,
Dahua SmartPSS **supports video structuring**. You can add a target detection module, which includes
**real-time target detection** for moving objects, such as vehicles and pedestrians. 

### Developer background and ecosystem

Dahua SmartPSS is developed by Dahua Technology, a major global provider of **video-centric AIoT
solutions**. The software is part of a broader ecosystem that includes **IP cameras, NVRs, DVRs, and
cloud services**, enabling seamless integration across surveillance hardware and software.

### Advanced AI and intelligent analytics

Recent versions of Dahua SmartPSS incorporate **AI-powered analytics**, including **facial
recognition, perimeter protection, and behavior analysis**. These features enhance traditional
monitoring by enabling **smarter threat detection**, reducing false alarms, and improving overall
surveillance efficiency in both residential and commercial settings.

### Remote access and mobile integration

The platform supports **remote monitoring capabilities**, allowing users to access live feeds and
playback from different locations. Integration with mobile apps like DMSS extends functionality,
enabling **real-time alerts, camera control, and notifications** directly on smartphones for
improved accessibility and convenience.

### Data storage and playback flexibility

With support for **multiple storage configurations**, including local drives, NVR systems, and cloud
options, the software provides **flexible video recording and playback solutions**. Users can easily
search footage using **time, event type, or smart detection filters**, making investigations faster
and more efficient.

### Security concerns and compliance discussions

As with many surveillance platforms, Dahua Technology has faced **global scrutiny regarding data
security and privacy practices**. Users are encouraged to follow **best practices**, such as
securing networks, updating firmware regularly, and limiting unauthorized access to ensure safe
usage.

### System requirements and performance considerations

While Dahua SmartPSS is feature-rich, it may require **moderately powerful hardware**, especially
when managing multiple high-resolution camera feeds. Performance can vary depending on the number of
connected devices, making **system optimization and proper configuration** essential for smooth
operation.

### A handy tool for your surveillance system

All in all, Dahua SmartPSS is **a must-have **[**device manager**][188] if you have the Dahua
surveillance system installed on your property. The app allows you to **manage your devices more
efficiently** and **configure them easily**. It lets you view real-time footage and even set alarms
for various events that you want to track. With this, you will no longer be caught off-guard
whenever something happens.

back.

patient care across single or multi-location practices.

# Cetyl Alcohol

## ELFAT^{TM} – CTO

Cetyl alcohol, also known as 1-hexadecanol, is a 16-carbon fatty alcohol used in cosmetics and
personal care products. It acts as an opacifier, emulsifier, and thickening agent while also
preventing skin dryness. It is deemed safe by the FDA for food and skin protectant use.

# Caustic Soda Flakes

## ELRASA^{TM} – CSF99

Caustic soda flakes, also known as sodium hydroxide flakes, are a solid form of caustic soda (NaOH)
that appear white and crystalline. Highly soluble in water, these flakes produce a strong alkaline
solution. As one of the most potent alkalis, caustic soda is extremely corrosive and widely
recognized for its versatility across industrial sectors. It remains one of the most essential
chemical compounds produced and supplied by leading caustic soda producers worldwide.

# Sodium Laureth Sulphate (SLES)

## ELSURFAC^{TM} – SES70

Elchemy supplies ELSURFAC™-SES70 Sodium Laureth Sulphate (SLES) in bulk to personal care, home care,
and industrial cleaning manufacturers across 40+ countries. SLES is a high-performance anionic
surfactant valued for its strong cleansing and foaming action with reduced irritation compared to
SLS, making it a workhorse ingredient in shampoos, body washes, hand soaps, dishwashing liquids, and
laundry detergents. Formulators planning a sodium laureth sulfate buy can source standard SLES 70%
in both 2EO and 3EO variants, with other active levels and customer-specific specifications
available on request. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for faster fulfillment to US
destinations.

# Linear Alkylbenzene Sulfonic Acid (LABSA)

## ELSURFAC^{TM} – LSA90

Elchemy supplies ELSURFAC™-LSA Linear Alkylbenzene Sulfonic Acid (LABSA) in bulk to detergent
manufacturers, household and industrial cleaning formulators, and chemical processors across 40+

][114]We discuss various types of electrical and electronic measurements. An explanation of
different bridge circuits, sensors, cathode ray oscilloscopes, digital meters, potentiometers,
transducers, and more. We explain working principles of various measuring instruments and measuring
systems.
[

## Electronics Devices Articles

][115]Learn about the many different types of electronic devices. We go over basic electronics,
semiconductors, diodes, transistors, LEDS, [Printed Circuit Boards][116], MOSFETS, and more.
[

## Digital Electronics Articles

][117]Digital Electronic deals with digital or discrete signals. We cover binary number systems,
binary arithmetic, boolean algebra, De Morgan theorems, K-map, logic gates, and binary to other
number system conversion. We also explain the basic electronic circuits of various logic gates.
[

## Electrical Power Generation Articles

][118]Learn about all types of electrical power generation systems including thermal, hydro, nuclear
power generation, solar panels, wind energy electric generation, cogeneration and more. We explain
the working principles and characteristics of different components of [power plants][119], like
boilers, turbines, economisers, solar panel, and wind turbines.
[

## Switchgear Articles

][120]Learn about all three types of electrical switchgear systems – low voltage switchgear, medium
voltage switchgear and high voltage switchgear – and the individual components of an electrical
switchgear system. We explain the mechanisms, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of different
parts of switchgear – including like CBs, CTs, CVTs, PT, isolators, and more.
[

## Power Transmission System Articles

][121]Articles related to electrical power transmission systems. Learn about different transmission
parameters, different materials used to construct a transmission line, HVDC systems, and different
theoretical approaches to power transmission. We discuss the design aspects of transmission towers
and their foundations.
[

## Electrical Generator Articles

][122]The electrical generator is the most basic as well as a most expensive component of a power
system. There are mainly two types of generators AC and DC Generator. One of the most common forms
of AC Generator is an alternator. We have provided various detailed articles on generators in this
generator section of the website – helping you to understand the basic concepts of generators.
[

## Electrical Transformer Articles

][123]We discuss all things related to transformers – from fundamental theory to modern advancement.
Learn about all different types of transformers – two winding transformers, autotransformers, power
and distribution transformers, single phase and three phase transformers – and more.

## [electronica—Empowering the All Electric Society][51]

Every two years, the world of electronics meets at electronica in Munich, Germany. As the world's
leading trade fair, it showcases the full range of technologies, products, and solutions that are
empowering an All Electric Society (AES). Practice-oriented forums and the world-class electronica
Automotive Conference provide in-depth insights into the latest research and application trends -
from automation with AI to electromobility and smart energy. More than 3,480 exhibitors and over
80,000 visitors from all over the world in 2024 make electronica the most important meeting place
and source of inspiration for the international electronics industry. This is where they work
together to shape a sustainable and livable future in the spirit of the All Electric Society.

## [electronica—Empowering the All Electric Society][51]

Every two years, the world of electronics meets at electronica in Munich, Germany. As the world's
leading trade fair, it showcases the full range of technologies, products, and solutions that are
empowering an All Electric Society (AES). Practice-oriented forums and the world-class electronica
Automotive Conference provide in-depth insights into the latest research and application trends -
from automation with AI to electromobility and smart energy. More than 3,480 exhibitors and over
80,000 visitors from all over the world in 2024 make electronica the most important meeting place
and source of inspiration for the international electronics industry. This is where they work
together to shape a sustainable and livable future in the spirit of the All Electric Society.

vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

# Imagine the CADabilities

Imagine the CADabilities along your workflow with exocad.

[Explore our software products][73]

## Summer school is in session

Ready for hot tips and cool new workflows? Join our amazing application specialists for our upcoming
summer school webinar series. From boosting case acceptance to accelerating design proposals with
AI, these classes will help make your work a breeze on the steamiest summer day.

[See schedule][74]

[Image exocad summer school]

## Powerful new PartialCAD 3.3 Chemnitz release available now!

PartialCAD 3.3 Chemnitz introduces a highly automated, guided split denture workflow that simplifies
design and speeds up production. From precise bar tops to enhanced post tools and automatic gingiva
thickness control, this release helps you achieve consistent, high-quality results with ease.

[Learn more][75]

[exocad HP slider PartialCAD Chemnitz]

## Browse our exocad webshop

Upgrade your *DentalCAD* license or purchase add-on modules anytime, anywhere from our exocad
webshop. We'll even help out with the initial installation and configuration of your new software
solution.

[Shop now][76]

[Webshop Grafik exocad HP slider]
[exoBlog HP banner Janos Panyi]

 

For many dental students, digital dentistry is still limited to a few classroom exercises. For Dr.
János Panyi, his curiosity pushed him to dive into digital long before graduation. In this exoBlog,
we hear how discovering exocad software through the student license helped János hone the skills he
now uses every day in practice.

[Read the interview][77]

## Why experts trust our digital dentistry solutions
* #### Faster workflows, improved proficiency
  
  Save time by working with high-performance software that runs robustly, even when dealing with
  large and complex cases. Quick response times and optimal usability help speed up your daily work.
* #### It’s easy to use and to reach your high expectations
  
  Your complex procedures can become more simple and efficient, thanks to our experience working
  closely with dental professionals like yourself, creating more accessible dental software for the
  digital age.
* #### Flexibility as you require it
  
  Experience maximum flexibility and freedom through exocad’s modular and open approach. It’s not
  just the software that is flexible, the business model is too. Mix and match modules, buy
  perpetual CAD software licenses, or rent the software at attractive rates – it’s all your choice.
* #### Reliability you can trust
  
  You can rely on us to create software that you will continue to appreciate and profit from. Our
  product has proven its stability time and time again, because we always pay the greatest attention
  to quality and to detail. Our reliable updates provide new possibilities that are always driven by
  your needs.
* #### Independent & innovative
  
  Our software puts you at the forefront of innovation. Since our foundation in 2010, our dedicated
  team of engineers and researchers has consistently developed state-of-the-art innovations for the
  dental industry. As the independent and hardware-neutral technology provider, our goal is to push
  the limits of digital dentistry through software solutions.
* #### Truly future-proof
  
  We’re the dental CAD/CAM software provider with the widest choice of integrated solutions using
  third-party scanners, mills, printers, and materials. And we are always open to new ideas, ready
  to support today’s and tomorrow’s best solutions to meet and exceed our customers’ requirements.

## How to purchase exocad software

exocad’s software solutions are distributed by a global network of trusted partners who also provide
easy-to-access after-sales service like installations, training and technical support. For product
support, offers or more information, please contact one of our partners.

Please note: ChairsideCAD and exoplan are certified as Medical Devices for distribution in selected
countries only. For further details please contact your reseller.

companies. Our comprehensive support system includes a worldwide network of [mentors][166],

market-ready businesses.

# Creating Clarity

We help pets lead fuller lives by giving veterinarians the tools, technology, and insights to see
clearly and get the answers they need.

[Learn how][264]

[A dog looks upwards, nuzzling a hand that is scratching it behind the ear.]

### Our difference

We innovate to advance veterinary medicine and help veterinary professionals practice at their best.

[See what drives us][269]
[Testtube Icon]

### IDEXX Reference Laboratories

An extension of your practice so you can focus on your patients.

[Online test directory][270] [IDEXX Reference Laboratories][271]

[SNAP tests][272] [In-house analyzers][273] [Diagnostic imaging][274]

### Practice management

Taking care of your practice
—from software to CE.

[CE for you and your team][275] [Practice management software][276]

### See cells like never before

Diagnose and act on clinically important cell types with reference laboratory-level accuracy, in
real time, with a slide-free workflow.

[Discover IDEXX inVue Dx][277]

## The best part of our technology is spending less time with it.

Save time and streamline your practice with our in-house analyzers.

[Meet the analyzers][278]
[A black cat with yellow-green eyes.]

## Need more clues? Ask a kidney.

Let the Catalyst SDMA Test uncover more about kidney health. 

[Learn more][279]
[A smiling dog with one ear flopped down and the other ear pointed up.]

## Not all reference labs are created equal

Learn how IDEXX Reference Laboratories goes above and beyond what you expect from a lab.

[Discover more][280]

* RACE-accredited courses
* Webinars and live events
* Learn seamlessly across any device

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is practice management software?

Practice management software is a digital tool that handles the administrative side of running a
healthcare practice: appointment scheduling, patient records, billing and reporting. It automates
routine tasks so your team spends time on patients, not paperwork.

How much does Medesk cost?

Medesk has a permanently free plan for up to 2 users, 1,000 patient records and 50 appointments per
month. The Pro plan starts at $16 per month per 50 appointments, with unlimited users and patient
records, and comes with a 7-day free trial. No credit card required.

Is Medesk secure and GDPR-compliant?

Yes. Data is encrypted in transfer and in storage, backups run automatically, and role-based access
rights control what each team member sees. Medesk is built for GDPR-compliant private practice.

Can I run video consultations with Medesk?

Yes. Telemedicine is built into the platform: turn any appointment into a video consultation with
one click, with no time limits, and run group sessions with up to 20 participants.

How long does it take to get started?

You can be ready to book patients in about 10 minutes: create your schedule, add services and share
your online booking link. Our team helps with setup and data transfer during free onboarding
consultations.

member of your team can see and do. Medesk is built for GDPR-compliant private practice.

away during the consultation.

segregate access based on the professional roles you assign to your colleagues.

questions and help you get the most out of Medesk.

Appointments sync daily with Google Calendar or iCal, keeping locations and times up to date.

What is practice management software?

Practice management software is a digital tool that handles the administrative side of running a
healthcare practice: appointment scheduling, patient records, billing and reporting. It automates
routine tasks so your team spends time on patients, not paperwork.

How much does Medesk cost?

Medesk has a permanently free plan for up to 2 users, 1,000 patient records and 50 appointments per
month. The Pro plan starts at $16 per month per 50 appointments, with unlimited users and patient
records, and comes with a 7-day free trial. No credit card required.

Is Medesk secure and GDPR-compliant?

rights control what each team member sees. Medesk is built for GDPR-compliant private practice.

Can I run video consultations with Medesk?

one click, with no time limits, and run group sessions with up to 20 participants.

## Mytonomy Use Cases

[iconOne]

### Virtual Classes for Joint Replacement, OB-GYN, and more

With staff shortages and consumer preferences, digitize and deliver on-demand joint education,
birthing classes, and more, complete with digital surveys (e.g., HOOS/KOOS, KCCQ) and automated
reminders, saving valuable staff time and allowing patients to conveniently prepare at home.

[horn]

### Improved Email Marketing & CRM

Dip into your rich video asset library from Mytonomy to improve your targeted email campaigns sent
by your existing CRM. Generate higher click/open rates and drive traffic to “no-login-required”
video portals that include your own content, resulting in thousands of hours of videos watched.

[crossHairs]

### Personalized Patient Education in your Epic/Cerner Portal

Big results for patients, fewer clicks for staff. Deliver microlearning patient education videos and
assets from a branded platform, integrated with your EHR, with a user interface that drives the
consumption of key messages. For example, trigger blood thinner videos for all discharged CABG
patients, or text your discharged heart failure patients their care plan.

[graph]

### Analyze population health metrics

Use data around your members to optimize value-based care, payment strategies, clinical offerings,
and more. Analyze condition data to improve risk scoring and health plan financial performance
across populations.

[PatientIphone]

### Patient Education Software Solution on your Smart TV and Tablets

Netflix-like experience for your hospital in a single platform that leverages Epic MyChart Bedside
and Cerner.

[arrows]

### The Telehealth “Sandwich”: Pre & Post Visit

Reach patients through their entire treatment cycle. With Mytonomy's patient health education
software, you can educate patients before and after care visits with microlearning videos and
resources so that you can build a deeper level of engagement with patients, and they can be more
prepared.

[funnel-1]

### Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) & Coaching

Use Mytonomy (or your own) content in your RPM solution or coaching practice. Mytonomy provides a
single place for all patient education resources and communications.

[computer]

### Research Trials

Our e-consent enables hands-free enrollment. Deliver custom video instructions to keep trial
participants motivated and in the know. Help providers better understand new therapies. Patients
learn what their role is in your study and how to complete it faster, better, and at less cost. We
support multiple-IRB site coordination and data management with a single source of truth and master
content management.

## Frequently asked questions

Still have questions?

[
See all FAQs
][58]
What is PatientNow?

PatientNow is the complete practice platform built only for aesthetic medicine: EMR, online booking,
marketing, payments, photo documentation, and business intelligence in one system. More than 5,000
active locations run on PatientNow worldwide.

What specialties does PatientNow serve?

PatientNow is built for aesthetic medicine: med spas, plastic surgery, dermatology, weight loss, IV
therapy, and wellness practices. The templates, workflows, and reporting already speak your
specialty's language.

What makes PatientNow different from general medical EMRs?

PatientNow is built exclusively for aesthetic practices, with before and after photo management,
cosmetic procedure templates, and aesthetic inventory tracking that generic systems bolt on or skip.

Can PatientNow handle both surgical and non-surgical work?

Yes. The platform manages everything from injectables to major surgical procedures, with the
documentation, scheduling, and billing workflows each side needs, in one system.

How long does it take to get started?

Most practices are up and running within weeks, not months. Our onboarding team handles data
migration, staff training, and setup, and onboarding is free.

How hard is it to switch from our current EMR?

Most practices are fully up and running within weeks. Our onboarding team handles data migration,
staff training, and setup at no extra cost. You keep seeing patients while we do the heavy lifting.

Do I need to sign a long-term contract?

No. PatientNow comes with no contract, free onboarding, and speedy setup. You stay because it works,
not because you signed something.

Do we own our data if we ever leave?

Yes. Your patient records are yours. Our team will help you export your data if you ever decide to
move on.

Is PatientNow HIPAA compliant?

Yes. Records are encrypted in transit and at rest, access is role-based, and audit trails track
every action. PatientNow also holds Meaningful Use certification.

## Frequently asked questions

Still have questions?

[
See all FAQs
][58]
What is PatientNow?

PatientNow is the complete practice platform built only for aesthetic medicine: EMR, online booking,
marketing, payments, photo documentation, and business intelligence in one system. More than 5,000
active locations run on PatientNow worldwide.

What specialties does PatientNow serve?

PatientNow is built for aesthetic medicine: med spas, plastic surgery, dermatology, weight loss, IV
therapy, and wellness practices. The templates, workflows, and reporting already speak your
specialty's language.

What makes PatientNow different from general medical EMRs?

PatientNow is built exclusively for aesthetic practices, with before and after photo management,
cosmetic procedure templates, and aesthetic inventory tracking that generic systems bolt on or skip.

Can PatientNow handle both surgical and non-surgical work?

Yes. The platform manages everything from injectables to major surgical procedures, with the
documentation, scheduling, and billing workflows each side needs, in one system.

How long does it take to get started?

Most practices are up and running within weeks, not months. Our onboarding team handles data
migration, staff training, and setup, and onboarding is free.

How hard is it to switch from our current EMR?

Most practices are fully up and running within weeks. Our onboarding team handles data migration,
staff training, and setup at no extra cost. You keep seeing patients while we do the heavy lifting.

Do I need to sign a long-term contract?

No. PatientNow comes with no contract, free onboarding, and speedy setup. You stay because it works,
not because you signed something.

Do we own our data if we ever leave?

Yes. Your patient records are yours. Our team will help you export your data if you ever decide to
move on.

Is PatientNow HIPAA compliant?

Yes. Records are encrypted in transit and at rest, access is role-based, and audit trails track
every action. PatientNow also holds Meaningful Use certification.

# Plastics Industry

## A Look at Plastics

The term “plastic” encompasses a broad range of materials. In addition, each has its own special
properties and variations when it comes to properties such as hardness, heat tolerance, and
resiliency. Nonetheless, each of them is made of organic condensation or addition polymers and can
be made into fibers, films, or objects.

There are [7 main types of plastics][5], anything from PET, used in food containers, to PVC, used in
pipes and flooring. Basically, plastics are everywhere in our modern world.

The plastics industry is a [very large industry][6] when many facets and worldwide reach. What is
expected from the plastics industry in [2023 and 2024][7].

* [Plastic Processing Methods][8]
* [Plastics and the Environment][9]
* [The Benefits of Plastic][10]
* [Types of Plastics:][11]
  * [Starting with the letter A][12]
  * [Starting with the letters C, D and E][13]
  * [Starting with the letters F, M and N][14]
  * [Starting with the letter P][15]
  * [Starting with the letters S, T and U][16]
  
   
* [How is Plastic Recycled?][17]
* [Injection Molding][18]
* [Employment and Jobs in the Plastics Industry][19]
* [Plastics and Nanotechnology][20]
* [Synthetic Rubber][21]
* [Recycling Plastics][22]
* [Plastic-eating Bacteria][23]

 


**Classifying Plastics**

There are many methods used to classify plastics. The most common method is to classify them
according to their polymer backbone. Plastics can, however, also be classified according to the
glass transition temperature or thermoplastic versus thermoset.

No matter the classification, [all plastics][24] are polymers, which is a long chain of atoms that
are bonded to one another. These chains are comprised of monomers, which are repeating molecular
units. Most plastics are made of carbon polymers or carbon polymers combined with nitrogen, oxygen,
sulfur, or chlorine in the backbone, which is the main path linking the units together. Plastic is
then customized by “hanging” different molecular groups to the backbone.


**History of Plastic**

Experiments with plastic have been performed for centuries. In fact, even the Old Testament makes
reference to natural materials that were used in the same way as plastic is used today. The exact
year when plastic was first created or discovered, however, is a matter of dispute because the term
“plastic” is so loosely defined.

The discovery of ebonite, or hard [rubber][25], in 1851, however, had a major impact on the plastics
industry. Ebonite was the first thermosetting material to be prepared that also involved its own
unique chemical modification of naturally occurring material. Yet, it took several years for ebonite
to be used to its potential.

As rubber technology was further being developed, collodion was also being manufactured. Collodion
is a cellulose solution that is part of an alcohol-ether mixture. Alexander Parkes, an English
inventor, noticed that a solid residue was left after solvent in the collodion evaporated. In his
word, this residue was a “hard, horny elastic and waterproof substance.” He later patented the
process in 1856 in order to waterproof woven fabrics.

In 1862, a new formulation was unveiled at the Great Exhibition in London. This early plastic was
created by dissolving cellulose nitrate in a solvent. After being placed on a heated rolling
machine, the mixture could be shaped. The first company to dedicated to manufacturing products from
the material, the Parkesine Company, was established in 1866. The company failed, however, in 1868.
A year later, the Xylonite Company was opened by Daniel Spill, who was an associate of Parkes. This
company also went bankrupt in 1874.

In the United States, [plastic compounds][26] were also on the rise. John Wesley Hyatt experimented
with cellulose nitrate in the 1860s. In 1865, he became involved in developing a method for creating
billiard balls with alternative materials. He developed balls made of ivory dust, cloth, and
shellac, which was covered with a collodion coating.

Wyatt and his brother, Isaiah, went on to create a process for producing a material made of camphor
and cellulose nitrate in 1870. By 1872, the term “celluloid” had been coined for the product. The
brothers went on to establish the Celluloid Manufacturing Company, which was later renamed the
American Cellulose Chemical Corporation and was ultimately absorbed by the Celanese Corporation.

By the 1900s, the use of [plastic][27] and all of its variations took off. Today, it is the most
used material in the United States industry, with nearly every product containing plastic in one way
or another.

Wyatt and his brother, Isaiah, went on to create a process for producing a material made of camphor
and cellulose nitrate in 1870. By 1872, the term “celluloid” had been coined for the product. The
brothers went on to establish the Celluloid Manufacturing Company, which was later renamed the
American Cellulose Chemical Corporation and was ultimately absorbed by the Celanese Corporation.

By the 1900s, the use of [plastic][27] and all of its variations took off. Today, it is the most
used material in the United States industry, with nearly every product containing plastic in one way
or another.

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. Frequently Asked Questions

Shobeir Shimi is a trusted supplier in the petrochemical and polymer industry, offering reliable

We coordinate sea, land, and multimodal transportation to ensure safe and timely delivery.

Built for medicine

## 12+ Years of Healthcare Marketing Experience in the Specialties That Actually Drive Your Revenue.

Most digital marketing agencies spend your first few months learning what an IVF patient is, why a
spine patient searches differently from an urgent care patient, or why sending paid traffic to a
homepage instead of a procedure-specific landing page is the single most common way practices waste
their marketing budget.

We come in already knowing. We’ve managed Google Ads, Meta, and SEO for fertility clinics, plastic
surgery practices, orthopedic groups, and international medical tourism clinics — across multiple
countries, languages, and patient markets. The campaigns we build on day one reflect years of
pattern recognition in the specialties that matter to your practice.

Procedure-specific campaigns, not generic healthcare ads
Every campaign is built around how your specific patients actually search — the keywords, intent
signals, and objections that convert in your specialty. Not a template applied to healthcare in
general.
Landing pages that convert, not just traffic that clicks
We proved the landing page effect with a plastic surgery client: CVR went from 0.8% on their generic
site pages to 7.2% on procedure-specific landing pages we designed. That’s 9x more leads from the
same ad spend.
Attribution that connects ad spend to actual patients
Call tracking, form submission events, WhatsApp click-to-chat, and GA4 configuration so every dollar
of marketing spend traces back to a real patient inquiry — not just a pageview.
Medical SEO built for E-E-A-T and algorithm resilience
Google’s helpful content and core updates hit healthcare hardest. We write medically credible
content that holds its rankings through algorithm changes — because we understand why Google
prioritizes expertise and trust in YMYL categories.

Who we work with

## If you’re in healthcare, we already know your patient.

Specialty depth beats generalist breadth — every time. We don’t spread thin across every industry.
We go deep in medicine, so your campaigns start converting faster.

## The patient management workflow

Curious what a day in the life of a clinician looks like in Welkin?

Manage patient care from diagnosis through ongoing treatment management.

#### Home

See your day at a glance. Home shows your schedule, tasks, unread communications and patient
escalations. This allows you to proactively plan your day and gives you the ability to swiftly react
to those who need attention.

#### Calendar

Schedule patient visits, encounters, or non-patient events, like team training. Multi-user views
show team availability and ensure shift coverage. The calendar API allows you to integrate your own
external calendars as well.

#### Patient Record

Customize and maintain comprehensive records of patients and their medical histories. Track
demographic information, vital signs, diagnoses, allergies, medication histories, treatment plans,
and lab results.

#### Assessments

Create assessments tailored to your program's needs and monitor patient progress at every stage of
care. Patient records and charts are updated real-time once responses are submitted and received.

Forms and assessments can be designed for scoring groups, conditionality, data charting and
reporting, and triggering automated program logic.
